column3: “Though” replaces for; they pluralizes the singular wise subject.
Casting wealth into the sea replaces striking the strength in the sea.
Mouths and teeth references are pluralized; clan renders leader, and Jebusites pluralizes Jebusite.
“My people” specifies them; keep watch interprets have seen.
The second-person sons of Greece is made third person.
“With slingstones” makes the stones an instrument rather than the object subdued; drenched is supplied.
“Like” makes crown stones a comparison; sparkle renders displaying themselves.
“They” replaces singular his in the description of goodness and beauty.
